## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤 (dt)

```sql
-- 取最新预测（最常见，~70% 查询）
WHERE dt = cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}" as string)

-- 评估场景：回溯 8 天前的预测
WHERE dt = cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-8d')}" as string)

-- 评估场景：回溯 3 天前的预测
WHERE dt = cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-3d')}" as string)
```

### 地域过滤 (country_name)

```sql
-- 标准 8 市场全集（recall/forecast 场景）
AND country_name in ('ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'VN', 'TW', 'BR', 'SG', 'MY')

-- 排除 SG 的子集（某些评估场景）
AND country_name in ('ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'VN', 'TW', 'BR', 'MY')

-- 变量形式（Presto/Spark 通用）
AND country_name IN ${regions}
```

### 预测日期范围 (forecast_date)

```sql
-- Recall 场景：未来 730 天
AND forecast_date >= cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','+0d')}" as string)
AND forecast_date <= cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','+730d')}" as string)

-- 短期评估：过去 7 天
AND forecast_date >= cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-7d')}" as string)
AND forecast_date <= cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}" as string)

-- 点查询（traffic boost 环境因子计算）
AND forecast_date = CAST(${run_date} AS VARCHAR)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 1. 与总展现量表 JOIN -- 计算关键词历史占比

```sql
-- forecast 表提供 region 级预测值，与总展现表 JOIN 后按关键词比例分配
WITH forecast_region AS (
    SELECT country_name AS grass_region, date(dt) AS grass_date,
           date(forecast_date) AS forecast_date, SUM(forecast_impression_count) AS forecast_imp_count
    FROM mkplpaidads_brand_ads.search_brand_ads_impression_forecast
    WHERE dt = cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}" as string)
      AND country_name in ('ID','TH','PH','VN','TW','BR','SG','MY')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
kw_ratio AS (
    SELECT grass_region, shop_id, keyword,
           SUM(imp_count) / CAST(SUM(total_imp_count) AS DOUBLE) AS imp_ratio
    FROM kw_total_imp_table
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT a.grass_region, a.shop_id, a.keyword, b.forecast_date,
       MAX(a.imp_ratio * b.forecast_imp_count) AS forecast_kw_imp
FROM kw_ratio a
LEFT JOIN forecast_region b ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
```

### 2. 与竞价模型表 JOIN -- env_t 环境因子

```sql
-- Traffic boost saturation 计算：用预测展现除以历史实际展现得到环境倍率
WITH actual_imp AS (
    SELECT grass_region, AVG(imp_count) AS avg_imp_count
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ods_brand_ads_search_volume_imp_cnt
    WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date_add('day', -32, ${run_date}) AND date_add('day', -3, ${run_date})
      AND grass_region IN ${regions}
    GROUP BY 1
),
forecast_imp AS (
    SELECT country_name AS grass_region, forecast_impression_count
    FROM mkplpaidads_brand_ads.search_brand_ads_impression_forecast
    WHERE dt = CAST(date_add('day', -3, ${run_date}) AS VARCHAR)
      AND forecast_date = CAST(date_add('day', -1, ${run_date}) AS VARCHAR)
      AND country_name IN ${regions}
)
SELECT a.grass_region,
       CAST(b.forecast_impression_count AS DOUBLE) / (a.avg_imp_count + 1e-9) AS env_t
FROM actual_imp a
JOIN forecast_imp b ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
```

## Common Aggregations

### Region 级聚合 -- 获取大盘预测值

```sql
SELECT country_name AS grass_region,
       date(dt) AS grass_date,
       date(forecast_date) AS forecast_date,
       SUM(forecast_impression_count) AS forecast_imp_count
FROM mkplpaidads_brand_ads.search_brand_ads_impression_forecast
WHERE dt = cast("${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}" as string)
  AND country_name in ('ID','TH','PH','VN','TW','BR','SG','MY')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### 多窗口聚合（评估场景）

```sql
-- 同一预测快照按不同时间窗口聚合
SELECT grass_region, '1d' AS window,
       SUM(forecast_impression_count) AS forecast_imp_count
FROM tmp_imp_forecast
WHERE grass_date = '${target_date}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION
SELECT grass_region, '7d' AS window,
       SUM(forecast_impression_count) AS forecast_imp_count
FROM tmp_imp_forecast
WHERE grass_date >= '${start_date}' AND grass_date <= '${end_date}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 4: Traffic boost env_t calculation

```sql
-- 0_presto: saturation analysis
-- 用 forecast 除以历史平均展现得到环境倍率（env_t）
forecast_imp AS (
    SELECT country_name AS grass_region, forecast_impression_count
    FROM mkplpaidads_brand_ads.search_brand_ads_impression_forecast
    WHERE dt = CAST(date_add('day', -3, ${run_date}) AS VARCHAR)
      AND forecast_date = CAST(date_add('day', -1, ${run_date}) AS VARCHAR)
      AND country_name IN ${regions}
)
SELECT a.grass_region,
       CAST(b.forecast_impression_count AS DOUBLE) / (a.avg_imp_count + 1e-9) AS env_t
FROM actual_imp a JOIN forecast_imp b ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
```
